scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-181
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-182 classifies the no-bias dense-linear fast-path frontier only.
This slice does not implement or select a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
This slice does not resolve the Candle output-storage blocker from SLM-CPU-181.
No runtime behavior changes are made in this slice.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 claim is made.

code_evidence.evidence: linear_with_optional_bias loads weight and treats missing bias as None, explicitly avoiding zero-bias tensor materialization and a runtime add for dense GGUF weights that omit bias.
linear_with_optional_bias_traced records model-init bias presence through model_init.linear_bias_finish with present true or false, then constructs Linear::new(weight, bias).
Attention q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, and o_proj are constructed through linear_with_optional_bias_traced, so model-init tracing can distinguish present bias from missing-bias no-bias roles.
Feed-forward gate_proj, up_proj, and down_proj are constructed through linear_with_optional_bias and can represent missing bias as None.

The lm_head Linear construction uses linear_with_optional_bias when a dedicated lm_head Linear is selected; output-head/tied-head handling has additional orientation-specific paths and therefore needs role-specific evidence.
Dense Q8 sidecar helpers accept optional bias and skip initial bias by using zero when bias is None, but still materialize bias values when bias exists.
Instrumentation records bias_materialization_calls, bias_materialization_ns, and bias_values_materialized, which are required counters for any future no-bias fast-path receipt.
DenseLinearOutputStorageApiBoundary exposes optional bias shape and bias_accessible=true for Candle Linear read-side inspection, but still marks caller-output storage unavailable.

receipt_evidence.evidence: The strict Qwen3 presizing receipt records bias_materialization_calls=0, bias_materialization_ns=0, and bias_values_materialized=0 while preserving strict GGUF tokenizer authority, cpu-rust, generated IDs, and fallback_used=false.
The strict Qwen2.5 presizing receipt records bias_materialization_calls=0, bias_materialization_ns=0, and bias_values_materialized=0 while preserving strict tokenizer/backend/fallback provenance.
The SLM-CPU-175 Qwen3 after receipt keeps bias_materialization_calls=0 and bias_values_materialized=0 after prompt-tokenize cache work; this is not proof that every dense-linear role is biasless.
The SLM-CPU-175 Qwen2.5 after receipt keeps bias_materialization_calls=0 and bias_values_materialized=0 after prompt-tokenize cache work; this is not proof that every dense-linear role is biasless.

SLM-CPU-178 already classifies no_bias_fast_path_feasibility as potentially useful later but runtime_candidate_available_now=false because no-bias skipping does not solve the owned Tensor output-storage boundary.

role_classification.reason: The constructor and trace surface can represent bias absence, but this artifact does not include a current model-wide Qwen3/Qwen2.5 manifest proving every attention projection role is biasless.

The constructor supports missing-bias no-bias Linear roles, but selected workspace output-storage boundary evidence currently reports bias_accessible=true for feed_forward.down_proj.output read-side inspection. That is not safe no-bias proof.

Output-head handling may use dedicated lm_head Linear, tied embeddings, or orientation-specific weight paths. A no-bias fast path needs exact role identity and bias-presence evidence for the selected output-head path.

Sidecar helpers can compute with absent bias by starting from zero, and receipts expose bias materialization counters. A runtime path is still unsafe until exact role bias absence and behavior-preserving receipt pairs exist.

runtime_disabled_gate.scope_if_implemented_later: role-specific dense-linear compute path that skips bias materialization/add only when the selected role is proven biasless
enable_conditions: A model-init trace or tensor manifest proves exact bias absence for each selected Qwen3 Q8_0 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0 dense-linear role.

The selected role is recorded explicitly, such as attention.q_proj, attention.k_proj, attention.v_proj, attention.o_proj, feed_forward.gate_proj, feed_forward.up_proj, feed_forward.down_proj, or lm_head.

Paired strict before/after receipts preserve model SHA, strict GGUF tokenizer authority, prompt IDs, generated IDs, decoded text, selected CPU backend/kernel, dense path identity, and fallback_used=false.
Receipts record requested and selected dense no-bias path identity plus fallback_used and fallback_reason for the no-bias selector.
Receipts record bias_materialization_calls, bias_materialization_ns, and bias_values_materialized for the selected role before and after.
No speedup, timing improvement, or allocation reduction is claimed without phase timing and allocation counters tied to the selected role.
fail_closed_conditions: Bias presence is unknown for the selected role.
A bias tensor is present for the selected role.
The selected role is lm_head/output_head and the exact output-head orientation/tied-head path is unknown.
Generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer authority, backend/kernel identity, or fallback status differ between before and after receipts.
The runtime path cannot emit no-bias dense path identity and bias materialization counters.

classification.reason: Current code can represent no-bias Linear roles and receipts show zero sidecar bias materialization calls in existing strict Qwen3/Qwen2.5 runs, but the committed artifacts do not prove every relevant dense-linear role is biasless. The no-bias fast path also does not resolve the broader Candle owned-output Tensor boundary from SLM-CPU-181.
classification.recommended_next_action: Capture or require a model-init bias-presence manifest for exact Qwen3/Qwen2.5 dense-linear roles before any no-bias fast-path implementation.
